nom: medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Resurfacing Toner

avis.texte: I dont normally write reviews but this prodcut has change the game for me. I use every night to fade my acne scars ans the progress is insane. Of course it doesnt come immediatley but I can definitely the difference.
Have had the weirdest time with acne, and this is helping so much with post-tret exfoliation and brightening up my dark spots!!
